verified_facts.text: ME Dubai is set inside The Opus building in Business Bay, Dubai.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Opus by Omniyat, Al Amal Street, Business Bay, Dubai

verified_facts.text: ME Dubai was designed by the architect Zaha Hadid.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by the visionary architect Zaha Hadid, ME Dubai embodies her innovative approach, where the fluidity of space converges with the elegant geometry of nature.

verified_facts.text: Every curved glass panel of the building's undulating void is unique.
verified_facts.excerpt: every curved glass panel of the undulating void is unique

verified_facts.text: The rooms come in two distinct themes: one avant-garde and cosmopolitan inspired by the city's nightlife, the other warmer and evocative of the desert around Dubai.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature two distinct themes. One is more avant-garde and cosmopolitan, inspired by the city's nightlife, while the other is warmer and more evocative, reminiscent of the vast desert surrounding Dubai.

verified_facts.text: Some rooms and suites look out on the Burj Khalifa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perfectly located, from this room you can admire the iconic Burj Khalifa.

verified_facts.text: Corner suites have two connecting bedrooms, views of the Burj Khalifa, a large Jacuzzi in the bathroom and a double rainshower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located at the corners of the building, it features 2 connecting bedrooms, each with a super-king-size bed and fantastic views of Burj Khalifa. It features a huge Jacuzzi in the bathroom and a double rainshower.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool has views of Dubai's skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: The stunning rooftop pool is a calm oasis in the heart of the city. With breathtaking views of Dubai’s skyline

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a wide range of massages and treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spa at the ME Dubai is an oasis of pampering and well-being: offering a wide range of stimulating massages, exclusive treatments and private showers with changing rooms.

verified_facts.text: The Health Club gym has views of the city and the pool, with personal training and fitness classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: 260m2 of space with views of the city and the pool, modern technology, and a supervised personal training programme plus exclusive fitness classes.

verified_facts.text: ME+ suite guests can book experiences such as a cocktail workshop with the mixologist or a guided tour of the hotel's architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: A workshop with our mixologist to make signature cocktails, a workshop with our chefs to prepare delicious desserts, a guided tour with our Aura team to learn about the architecture of the ME Dubai

verified_facts.text: ME+ suites include private check-in and a direct line to the Aura team for reservations.
verified_facts.excerpt: private check-in and a direct line with our Aura team for any reservations you would like to make inside or outside the hotel

verified_facts.text: Roka serves Japanese cuisine from the robata grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: The principle cuisine is from the Robata grill, originally used by the fishermen in the northern seas of Japan

verified_facts.text: Salmon Guru is a cocktail-gastro bar in the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: this cocktail-gastro bar is the perfect place to hang out after a day of work or exploration

verified_facts.text: The hotel is across the street from the Dubai Canal's waterfront promenade.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cross the street and stroll along the Dubai Canal’s waterfront promenade

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the immediate area is a bit quiet and still being developed.
verified_facts.excerpt: the immediate area is a bit quiet and still being developed

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a pet programme for dogs with no weight limit.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have an exclusive programme for dogs, with no weight limit

verified_facts.text: There is a focus on art and curated exhibitions alongside furniture designed by Hadid.
verified_facts.excerpt: there’s a focus on art and curated exhibitions alongside Hadid’s specially designed furniture

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says to book an east-facing room for a Burj Khalifa view.
verified_facts.excerpt: For a Burj Khalifa view, book a room that looks east.
